correctness.rationale: For three equally spaced default-delegation voters under independent turnout p∈(0,1), q=1−p, normalized tolerance t=τ/h≥0, reconstructed expected first-caster payoff U_i=pτ+hpq F_i, F_i=sum q^{j−1}(t−distance in units h) over unique delegate path. All 27 profiles reduce to 15 reflection classes. Explicit binding one-step gains classify PNE at α=(1+2q)/(1+q), γ=1+1/q, while welfare comparison between 2(t−1),3(t−1)+q(t−2),(1+q)(3t−4) changes optimum at β=1+1/(2q). Hence Δ=hpq[2q(t−1)−1] for β<t≤γ, zero otherwise. Independently enumerated all 8 turnout subsets for all 27 profiles, deviations and welfare at 3 rational p choices and 9 tolerance values including threshold ties, reproducing every set and gap. This is fully analytic for all p,t rather than finite sampling.
